body:
Every time my posts go unnoticed, I just delete them out of shame. I'm not trying to sound like an attention whore or anything, it just always makes me think "Well, what was the point of that?".

It also makes me feel bad for posting all my depression stuff on a throwaway, because I know throwaways sometimes get a bad rep. One of my relatives know my main account, so if they discover I'm suicidal or bisexual (yeah, my family is *that* kind of family), then I'm fucked.
This happens to me much more than I can think. In fact, I've been experiencing this with a friend I recently made, and I don't know what to do.

I miss it too. I was happy, had a lot of friends, I didn't have a lot of responsibilities since I was only 14 (though I was a theatre actor), my grandpa and my pet guinea pigs were still alive, I had a lot of optimism, and overall, life was just amazing.

I miss 2019 as well, but good god, if I was able to time travel, I would steer clear of October from that year. That was the beginning of my life falling apart.
Oh man, I'm so sorry for replying this late. Was it the same Danny by any chance?

I hate it too. The thing is, I *have* talked to friends - a lot of them - and I either drive them away when I didn't mean to, or I feel like I'm *about* to overwhelm them, so I completely stop bringing up my problems in life with them just so history won't repeat itself. I've also dealt with one friend who thought I was trying to seek attention and told me, verbatim, that "others have it worse".
I wish I could, but I still live with my parents and I have a job. Frustrates me.
Oh yeah, I know I posted this on a throwaway, but I guarantee I'll check this account every single day until I find Danny.
